title: Phân tích và Đầu tư Chứng khoán

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental and technical analysis in stock market.
Identify and manage risks in stock investment.
Construct and manage diversified investment portfolios.
Develop financial models to value stocks and manage investments.
Effectively communicate investment analysis and strategies.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and discussions.
Continuously improve knowledge and skills through self-study.
Analyze and solve problems related to stock investment and risk management.
